analysis:
This PR adds add-on hold load fences (TB-012, A-018, T-059). They are availability controls only; no crypto, attestation or authorization path changes.

NemotronSuper (head):
- Line 46 adds addonHoldLoadRefusal before GPUEnforcement and acquireResliceGate. The refusal escapes loadNemotronSuperSlot uncaught, after the weight hash is published but before any reslice, so nothing needs release.
- Line 170 adds a recheck inside publishNemotronSuperSlot before engineV2Runtime.register and modelSlots publication. On a throw, installNemotronSuperSlot (123) retires the unpublished owner and restores the reslice; loadNemotronSuperSlot (55) releases the reslice gate and maps the error via nemotronSuperLoadFailure. The refusal type is unknown: if it is not InferenceError.modelLoadFailed, it is recorded as 'native construction was refused' (benign). Cleanup ordering matches the existing throwIfRetiring path, so resources are released or retained.

NativeMiMo:
- The head-251 check sits beside throwIfRetiring in the recheck. The visible unit (lines 522-676) is unchanged retirement logic, examined only for context.

ModelLoading (metadata only, no source unit):
- The patch excerpt shows fences at head 396-397 before isLoadingAny, and at 576-577 after hashing.
- At head 711, modelLoadInterruption replaces the isShuttingDown || Task.isCancelled check. The excerpt is truncated, so integration should verify that modelLoadInterruption still includes both shutdown and cancellation.
- Changes at 942-948, 1041-1048 and 1202-1203 were not visible.

The add-on socket signature check and lease semantics (T-059) are outside the supplied evidence. No regression was identified in the visible lines.
